description.short_caption: Gram stain of CSF showing gram-positive cocci in clusters.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a gram stain of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Numerous gram-positive cocci, appearing as purple spherical organisms, are visible in clusters. The background is lightly stained, consistent with the fluid matrix of CSF. The organisms' morphology and arrangement suggest a bacterial etiology, potentially indicative of a staphylococcal infection.
